test_title: PYST 04: SSC MTS 2024 - Reasoning Ability and Problem Solving (Held On: 07 Oct, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: A, B, P, Q, Y, and Z are sitting around a circular table facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). Q sits to the immediate left of B. Y sits to the immediate right of B. A sits second to the right of B. P sits second to the right of A. Who sits third to the right of Z?
solution:
Given:

A, B, P, Q, Y, and Z are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

Q sits to the immediate left of B. Y sits to the immediate right of B.

A sits second to the right of B. P sits second to the right of A

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6aa6fcbbbb5e22433146ddb87028af6ac1af38ae9f7427c04fabf665b04b539d.png] 

Thus, **'B'** sit third to the right of Z.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
